summary: WelcomeStaffAdmin manages the staff administrative interface, providing functionalities like last login display and site-disbursement dropdowns.
purpose: To facilitate administrative tasks for staff members within the HSPnet system.

workflows.name: Initial Page Load
steps: Display the main interface for staff.

business_rules: Page must display last login information if available.
Dropdowns must be filled with valid site and discipline data.
validations: Check presence of UserSession before actions.
conditions: UserSession must be valid for data fetching.
system_behavior: Dropdowns are dynamically populated based on session data.
exceptions: Cancelling data load if session data is missing.
